text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, computers can produce art, music, and even writing that looks or sounds like the work of humans. Some people worry that this will replace human artists, but others believe it is simply a new tool. Human creativity comes from emotions, personal experience, and imagination, while machine creativity is based on patterns in data. In my opinion, AI can help people create faster and try new ideas, but it cannot truly feel or understand what it makes. The best results may come when humans and machines work together.
